title: Cut hard only where nobody can see the cut
text: Under B-roll the sound is cut tight (18 cuts under one 46 s CCTV piece). Where the live studio picture already changes camera, long stretches stay whole (10-76 s, no cut): the broadcast director's cuts already give the picture pace. Pace is uneven on purpose.
